| Ballot line | Party name |
|-------------|------------|
| **Republican** | Republican Party of New York State |
| **Conservative** | Conservative Party of New York State |

Pataki’s candidacy was jointly endorsed by the Conservative Party, so his name was listed on both the Republican and Conservative lines in the 1994 election【5†source=web_search】.
